issue.title: Compile error for `x86_64-unknown-motor` target
issue.body:
rustc 1.101.0-nightly (21b707e3f 2026-09-30)
build with `-Zbuild-std`
target: `x86_64-unknown-motor`
```
error[: unresolved imports `super::motor::SplitPathsRef`, `super::motor::split_paths_ref`
   ╭▸ /rustc/21b707e3f97e0b522ebd2f277a862339625ad83f/library/std/src/sys/paths/mod.rs:20:45
   │
20 │                 JoinPathsError, SplitPaths, SplitPathsRef, chdir, current_exe, getcwd, home_dir,
   │                                             ━━━━━━━━━━━━━ no `SplitPathsRef` in `sys::paths::motor`
21 │                 join_paths, split_paths, split_paths_ref, temp_dir,
   │                                          ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ no `split_paths_ref` in `sys::paths::motor`
   │
   ╰ help: consider importing one of these structs instead:
           crate::env::SplitPathsRef
           crate::sys::paths::unsupported::SplitPathsRef
help: a similar name exists in the module
   ╭╴
20 -                 JoinPathsError, SplitPaths, SplitPathsRef, chdir, current_exe, getcwd, home_dir,
20 +                 JoinPathsError, SplitPaths, SplitPaths, chdir, current_exe, getcwd, home_dir,
   ╰╴
help: a similar name exists in the module
   ╭╴
21 -                 join_paths, split_paths, split_paths_ref, temp_dir,
21 +                 join_paths, split_paths, split_paths, temp_dir,
   ╰╴

For more information about this error, try `rustc --explain E0432`.
error: could not compile `std` (lib) due to 1 previous error

```

nodes.body:
> the breakage is fresh: https://does-it-build.noratrieb.dev/target?target=x86_64-unknown-motor
> 
> [@lasiotus](https://github.com/lasiotus)

Nora - thank for tagging me! @maxdexh seems to be on top of this - thanks, Max!

I guess someone changed stdlib to require SplitPathsRef without making sure all targets build successfully...
We don't have a good way to check all t3 targets /shrug

source.title: Add `SplitPathsRef` implementation for motor to make std build
